assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
Prolonged ambulatory monitoring is indicated to detect intermittent arrhythmias that may contribute to hemodynamic instability or embolic risk
The indication note explicitly states that this diagnostic procedure is necessary to address the patient's recurrent symptoms and prior cerebrovascular events
